title: Animation events — config/animation-events.json
description: Every animation event the game can play. Per CONVENTIONS §9.8 each event defines duration, easing, skippable, skipTo, blocksInput, audioEvent, reduced-motion and low-performance variants, and a recovery policy. Skipping or fast-forwarding an event can NEVER alter a committed outcome.

events.description: All animation events, unique by eventId (uniqueness enforced by the config validator).

animEventId.description: Animation event id in dot notation: anim.<context>.<name>, e.g. anim.scatter.land.

timelineId.description: Kebab-case id of a deterministic timeline in the client timeline engine.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event, e.g. anim.scatter.land.

trigger.description: snake_case trigger that fires this event: a state-machine state entry or a step/presentation event, e.g. symbol_landed, presenting_wins.

conditions.description: Optional filters narrowing when the trigger fires this event. All present conditions must match.

symbolId.description: Only fire for this symbol, e.g. SCATTER.

tierId.description: Only fire for this feature tier.

winTier.description: Only fire for this win-size tier.

stepType.description: Only fire during this manifest step type.

minScatterCount.description: Only fire when at least this many scatters are visible (e.g. anticipation).

preconditions.description: Ids of other animation events that must have completed before this one may start (sequencing, e.g. countup after last cascade).

timelineId.description: Standard-motion timeline played for this event.

durationMs.description: Nominal duration in milliseconds at 1x speed.

easing.description: Easing curve name implemented in the deterministic timeline engine, e.g. easeOutBack, linear.

priority.description: Scheduling priority; higher wins when events compete for the same layer (100 = must play).

layer.description: Render layer this event animates on.

blocksInput.description: Whether player input (spin, UI) is locked while this event plays.

skippable.description: Whether the player can skip this event. Skipping affects presentation only.

skipTo.description: Where a skip lands: this event's end state (complete), the next manifest step (next_step), or the feature summary (summary).

fastForwardFactor.description: Playback speed multiplier applied in quick/turbo modes (1 = not accelerated).

audioEvent.description: Audio event synchronized with this animation, or null for silent events. Non-null ids must exist in config/audio-events.json.

hapticEvent.description: Haptic pulse fired with this event on supporting devices, or null.

reducedMotionTimelineId.description: Mandatory reduced-motion variant timeline (accessibility): same information, minimal movement, flash rate ≤ 3/s.

lowPerformanceTimelineId.description: Mandatory low-performance variant timeline for weak devices (fewer particles, simpler shaders).

recoveryPolicy.description: What happens if this event is interrupted by disconnect/reload: seek presentation to the committed state, restart the event, or skip it entirely.
